claims: Jordan Spieth has won three major championships in his career.
Jordan Spieth won the 2015 Masters Tournament with a record-tying performance.
Jordan Spieth won the 2015 U.S. Open at Chambers Bay.
Jordan Spieth won the 2017 Open Championship at Royal Birkdale.
Jordan Spieth has 13 total PGA Tour victories.
Jordan Spieth is a former World No. 1.
Jordan Spieth is currently one victory away from completing the career Grand Slam.
Jordan Spieth is missing only the PGA Championship for the career Grand Slam.
Jordan Spieth needs a PGA Championship victory to complete the set of all four major titles.
At age 23, Jordan Spieth joined Jack Nicklaus as one of the few players to win three different majors before age 24.
Jordan Spieth finished T3 in the 2021 Masters.
Jordan Spieth finished T4 in the 2024 Masters.
Jordan Spieth won two majors in 2015: the Masters and the U.S. Open.
Jordan Spieth finished second in the 2015 PGA Championship.
Jordan Spieth finished second in the 2015 Open Championship.
Jordan Spieth's last major win was in 2017.
